title: Охота на Вику и браслет Саши  (Pursuing Vika and Sasha's Bracelet)

segments.t: Peering through the office window into the dining room, Aleksandr asks Max whether art director Vika is seeing anyone and immediately sets his sights on her. Moments later, Vika steps in to tell the new chef that guests are waiting to greet him, while Sasha shows off her bracelet at the bar.
Слушай, а вот это, Луи, с кем?
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
Слушай, а вот это, Луи, с кем?

'Listen, who is Louis over there with?' Asking who Louis over there is cuts straight through the tension between Vika and Louis. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
'Come on, I am just kidding.' Because Louis should come on he is just kidding, Senya treats the matter as settled.

'And what about our director?' Over the room and the plan, Louis presses Senya for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'She does not seem to be with anyone.' Mentioning that she does not seem to be with anyone moves the talk in a new direction.
'You do not say.' Senya reminds Louis that Louis does not say before the moment passes.

'Actually, the guests were asking for you.' Because the guests were asking for Senya, Louis treats the matter as settled. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
'Tell them for me.' Vika mentions that Louis should tell them so Louis sees what is at stake.
'No, no, not right now.' Around the office and shift, Senya sets a calm, everyday tone with Louis.
'It is my first day at the restaurant.' Claiming that it is his first day at the restaurant sounds confident, even if Senya has doubts.

'Well, how could anyone say no to me?' Wondering how anyone say no could is how Vika puts Louis on the spot. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'This is already the third bracelet.' Senya explains that this is already the third bracelet, keeping his voice calm and direct.

'Do you see this right here?' By asking whether Senya sees this right here, Louis presses Senya for a straight answer. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.

'All right, I am going to get back to work.' Noting that all right she is going to get back to work keeps Vika's side of the story simple and clear. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Слушай, а вот это, Луи, с кем?
That wraps up this scene as aleksandr sets his sights on art director Vika after learning she is single, while Sasha shows off a new bracelet at the bar. Until next time!
